caption: Temples of Paestum, Paestum
composition: Doric Greek temple on the archaeological plain · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera rests low on the grassy plain beside one of Paestum's great Doric temples in the golden light of the 07:27 morning. Massive fluted columns march along the right side of the frame, carrying the weathered entablature, with scattered fallen blocks strewn at the base and morning mist hanging behind the umbrella pines at the left. The low sun warms the honey-colored stone while the long shadows stretch across the dew-covered grass.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the temples of Paestum under clear dawn light
